content: CLIR systems retrieve documents written in a language that is different from search query language BIBREF0 . The primary objective of CLIR is to translate or project a query into the language of the document repository BIBREF1 , which we refer to as Retrieval Corpus (RC). To this end, common CLIR approaches translate search queries using a Machine Translation (MT) model and then use a monolingual IR system to retrieve from RC. In this process, a translation model is treated as a black box BIBREF2 , and it is usually trained on a sentence level parallel corpus, which we refer to as Translation Corpus (TC).
